HIV-coinfected BU patients present with more severe lesions, and the use of ART in BU/HIV patients is associated with a higher incidence of paradoxical reactions and a better outcome.

The main takeaway from our work is that
BU/HIV-1 coinfection is common and is associated with large lesions.
BU/HIV- coinfection is not uncommon in Ghana and the management of such coinfection is a challenge.
